news.text: #Juve, another headache: #Locatelli undergoes surgeryMeniscus tear[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

THE CLOUD OVER #SPALLETTI#Juve, Fantozzi-style bad luck (Fantozzi is an Italian fictional character known for his extreme bad luck): 9 KOs! #Locatelli shock: he's going under the knife. And #Boga is out: muscle trouble.The sequence of bianconero injuries is impressive. For the captain, in addition to the meniscus, they fear there is further damage to the right knee: out for at least 3 months. For the Franco-Ivorian, there is a risk of a muscle strain. The manager is forced to rely on #Koopmeiners and #DouglasLuiz, the 'leftovers' of the mercato. #Giuntoli's swipe: "I see that my signings are useful now...".[Front Page TuttoSport]

🇮🇹😅 "#Frattesi was a player on whom #Juventus had made evaluations, but they didn't find the right match with #Inter. There had been talk of a swap deal involving #Cambiaso, but both parties ultimately chose not to proceed. It was a signing that #Spalletti had already been pushing for back in January, but then the decision was made not to go forward to pursue other strategies instead."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
Manuel #Locatelli will undergo surgery on his lateral meniscus. A 100-day layoff is projected for the #Juventus captain, who will return to the pitch in January.[Nico Schira]

👀⁉️ "Among the other players proposed is also #Bissouma, freed from #Tottenham. He also carries somewhat of a physical question mark, but he is another player being offered repeatedly in recent days to Italian clubs as well. We will see what kind of decisions #Juventus will make, but it is clear that they are experiencing a situation of major emergency."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇭🇷🧐 "#Brozovic would gladly return to Italy. He is being offered to everyone, we will see if anyone chooses to move forward, though for now there has been no sign of that kind. He is not making it purely a matter of money: he is ready to listen to opportunities. We will see if #Juventus, in light of their current injury emergency, will want to make evaluations. To date, there are no reports of any negotiations being opened."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇮🇹❌ "#Locatelli is ready for a specialist consultation in Lyon and, within the #Juventus camp, everyone believes that there is a 99.9% chance he will have to undergo surgery for a meniscus problem. We are not talking about a cruciate ligament injury, which can keep a player out for 6/7 months, so it is nothing extremely grave, but he will still have to remain sidelined for a while."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🆙🇮🇹 #Locatelli will have to undergo surgery for his lateral meniscus injury. The most recommended solution appears to be a suture, which would involve at least 3 months of recovery. #Owusu among the possible reinforcements from the #NextGen squad. [TuttoSport via @Juventus_Reborn]
#Locatelli's injury is a serious problem.[Antonio Corsa]

They're talking about an outer meniscus issue for #Locatelli, with a 3-4 months recovery time. After Yildiz and Thuram, Juventus needs to be deeply rethought just six days after the closure of the mercato.[Momblano]

🇮🇹‼️ For #Locatelli, they fear it is a meniscus problem. A possible surgical intervention is being evaluated, otherwise they will proceed with conservative therapy. The captain is heading toward missing the matches against #Sassuolo, #NEC and #Atalanta, with recovery time still to be determined.[Corriere dello Sport via @Juventus_Reborn]

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti to 'SportMediaset': "Is there anticipation for #Woltemade? We have to find out and we will do it together. He has potential, he is physical and he can give us something from a finishing perspective".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti to 'SportMediaset': "Do the jeers for #KoloMuani mean there is a problem? There will be a problem for you at the end of the championship when you'll have to say different things to what you say now. It will be your problem, you will regret it".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti to 'SportMediaset': "#Gatti scored a striker's goal? He has those exact qualities, he always believes he can score inside the penalty box. Then we were unlucky at times with those balls crossed inside. #KoloMuani managed to carve out space for himself once, but then he didn't have the right luck. However, we are happy with what we managed to achieve".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti to 'SportMediaset': "You chase after events, we have tried to anticipate and determine them. Reaching the equalizer at the very end means that the team continued to do what it was supposed to do. I liked this character and this reaction, just as I liked the whole match. The forwards could have done a bit more, we were often right at the edge of the box. But we were up against #Milan, a team of great substance and very high quality. It can happen that you lack the right intuitions or through-balls, we work to always be something more, match after match, day after day. And against #Milan, I saw better things compared to the previous two games".[@juventusinsidernews]
